messages:
elaine: Quick async on private deploy roadmap. Need decisions on packaging profiles, upgrade lanes, and customer-managed networking before Wed.
jasper: Short list please. We should lock installer UX (CLI vs console) and acceptable downtime for patch upgrades.
maria: Field feedback: prefer two profiles named 'edge' and 'core'. Edge = minimal footprint, no relay; Core = relay enabled + support hooks. They also want an "egress manifest" for firewall teams.
frank: Upgrade ask from infra: minor semver bumps should be in-place with rolling operator updates; majors require an explicit migration step. Need to confirm KV cache compatibility matrix.
jasper: Engineering proposal: CLI-first installer for alpha; console flow in later quarter. Preflight smoke test that blocks install on failed egress/DNS/TLS checks.
netops: For networking we classify three modes: relay-hosted, customer-egress (outbound-only), and isolated/offline. Each needs a different egress manifest and test script.
elaine: Roadmap proposal: Q3 alpha = edge/core profiles + preflight + egress manifest template; Q4 = minor in-place upgrades with canary and auto-revert; Q1 next = major migration tooling and operator-runbook.
maria: Pilots want a clear revert token and a canary policy (suggest 1 node or 5% workload). Also want the egress manifest in an easy copy-paste format.
frank: Note: runtime guarantees KV cache forward-compat only for minor bumps. Major schema migration will require operator hooks and manual verification. Include that in launch criteria.
jasper: Preflight should run: DNS resolution, TLS handshake to control-plane, outbound to egress endpoints, and operator RBAC checks. Failure returns remediation steps.
netops: We'll draft the one-pager egress manifest + a small curl-based test script customers can run. Security review needed for any allowlist wording.
deploy-bot: Created ticket RDW-PRIV-900 in Jira: "edge/core profiles + preflight + egress manifest".
elaine: Action items: jasper draft installer templates + preflight (1w); frank draft major/minor upgrade runbook + revert token prototype (2w); maria recruit pilots (2w); netops produce egress manifest + test script (1w). Flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
